name: B10-0449/2025 (The Left) – Situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Belarus, five years after the 2020 presidential election it calls stolen. It condemns the government's repression, welcomes the release of some political prisoners but says over a thousand remain held, and calls for all of them to be freed. It also asks the European Union to make visas easier for people fleeing Belarus and to adjust sanctions so ordinary citizens suffer less.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** The EU, its member states, and people in Belarus, including those fleeing.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and the Belarusian authorities.
